text:
Anika (PM): quick sync — post-launch followup plan. We need to decide split for next 2-week micro-sprint: more stability (bugs/regression fixes) or push small feature set (polish + 2nd wave). thoughts?
Diego (Eng): leaning stability. we saw a few customer-facing regressions in streaming and a 5% uptick in 5xxs yesterday. can we quantify impact?
Sam (SRE): telemetry: overall error rate spiked 0.8% -> 1.4% yesterday during peak region eu-west-1. top errors: KV cache eviction race, and a streaming TTL issue. logs: `gzipped-errors` has most traces.
Priya (Prod): ACME pilot reported truncated outputs on long prompts twice. they flagged as P1 for them. also several feature requests for richer metadata in embeddings (customer ask).
Jamal (CS): high-value customers (ACME, Nimbus) said they'd pause rollout if truncations continue. strong signal to fix.
Diego (Eng): ok — those truncations seem tied to KV cache TTL mismatch. estimate 2 dev-days to patch + 1 day of canary.
Anika (PM): What about the 2 small features we wanted: per-route cost breakdown in console + optional compact embeddings endpoint? each is ~3 dev-days.
Priya (Prod): per-route cost breakdown = high ops value but not blocking customers. compact embeddings has several asks from mid-market sales.
Sam (SRE): ops impact: if we reserve cycles for bugs we'll reduce incident risk. recommend 60% stability / 40% feature for this sprint. canary + rollback plan prepared.
Diego (Eng): team capacity math: with current headcount that becomes: 6 dev-days for bugwork, 4 dev-days for features (rough). owners?
Anika (PM): propose decision: prioritize stability first — target mitigation for truncation + KV cache fix as must-have. do a small polish batch (compact embeddings research spike) as stretch. If bugs are closed by day 7 we'll roll features into day 8+.
Priya (Prod): +1. also request we add an extra acceptance test for long prompts in the CI matrix. prevents regression.
Jamal (CS): I'll draft customer comms template for an interim workaround (shorter chunking) and notify ACME that we're on it.
Diego (Eng): I'll pick up KV cache patch (owner: Diego). Sam, can you run the canary in us-east-1 after deploy?
Sam (SRE): yes — will run canary, monitor `error_rate`, `truncation_count`, and `latency_p95`. set alert thresholds: error_rate >1% or truncation_count >5/min.
Anika (PM): action items: 1) Diego — KV cache patch & truncation fix (ETA: day 3) 2) Sam — canary + alerts (ETA: day 4) 3) Priya — CI acceptance test for long prompts (ETA: day 5) 4) Jamal — customer comms + interim workaround (today) 5) Diego/Priya — spike on compact embeddings (stretch)
Diego (Eng): putting tasks in tracker now. tag: sprint/2770.
ops-bot: Deployment window reserved: 2028-05-02 03:00-04:00 UTC for canary (auto-note).
Anika (PM): ok let's run 60/40 plan this sprint. we'll re-evaluate at next sync (Thu). Thanks all. :thumbsup:
Priya (Prod): noted. I'll also add a small metric card for truncation in the dashboard.
Jamal (CS): ping me if we need to escalate to enterprise support for ACME.
Diego (Eng): thanks — will post updates in this thread as things land.
Sam (SRE): will monitor and post canary results.
Anika (PM): closing loop — decision: prioritize stability mitigations first; features are stretch depending on bug closure. meeting adjourned.
